runbook.lesson: Long-running PDF OCR and layout extraction must execute in asynchronous background queues with dual status signaling (WebSockets for real-time push and HTTP polling for network resilience), temporary files must be cleaned up on all worker completion or error paths, and domain services must maintain strict separation between metadata extraction and document CRUD.
runbook.prevention: Never execute blocking multi-page vision-language or OCR operations synchronously on Express request threads; always return HTTP 202 with an extraction jobId when job queues are operational.
